d:
Serbia has witnessed a remarkable political shift as a student-led movement challenged the politics of strongman President Aleksandar Vučić, defeated him in the elections & wiped out the opposition.
In episode 1926 of , ThePrint Editor-in-Chief Shekhar Gupta explains how the movement built credibility & turned street protests into political power, and looks at the challenges that lie ahead for Serbia’s new political force. This episode also examines Vučić’s journey, Serbia’s complex history, the breakup of Yugoslavia and the unresolved Kosovo question.
